classic_pat_reason: Fine-grained PATs with personal resource_owner cannot write to org-owned repos via Git Data API (HTTP 403 on /git/blobs)
scope_required: repo (Contents:Write + Git Data API write on org repos)
notes: GH_TOKEN (classic PAT) must be mapped to GITHUB_TOKEN before any live PR creation. Current GITHUB_TOKEN may be fine-grained and may fail on org repos.
